about.what: release against change (decision E4 of 01_paper/v4_rescope/_ext_review/TRIAGE_RESULTS.txt): per log, method and pool the rows on which an edit is released, the rows whose pre-edit answer is not reproduced (D1), D1 among the rows with a release, and the NUMBER of rows without a release whose answer changed
about.release: row flag `fired` of the per-row files: an edit is released on the sequence (gates at the last prompt position: at that position; ReScope-W: at any position)
about.aggregation: percentages are means over the calibration draws (or complaint streams) of the per-run percentages; every run is listed with numerator and denominator (by_run); 'changed among released' averages the runs that release on at least one row

pools.hd_far: heldout_disjoint rows that share no question with an edit of the log
pools.hd_near: heldout_disjoint rows that ask the question of an edit of the log
pools.HN-I: near-scope negatives HN-I (image of an edit, other question)
pools.HN-Q: near-scope negatives HN-Q (question of an edit, other image)
pools.HN-X: near-scope negatives HN-X (image of one edit, question of another)

about.reading: low D1 does not imply accurate scope detection: the repair is conservative in its effect on answers, not selective in release; near-scope queries are outside the guarantee
about.E3_draws: behavioural calibration draws 0-2 (draw 0 only from 1000 edits on); where_logonly has no calibration (one run)

where_least_n10.title: ReScope-W, least repair of 10 complaints from the log-only thresholds (E2 b; H1 row)
